about: Worked example: the facts the reader should store for US-6063 from fixtures/blm-red-cliffs-recreation-area.page.txt (the page text the owner saved) plus the map address he pasted. Field names are the contract; change one only with a note in your pull request. Where the saved TEXT cannot show a thing the live page would (the heading tag, the links), the value is marked so.
